articles.title: FBI Director Kash Patel caught sleeping on required disclosure of six-figure MSTR investment: Report
articles.snippet: Patel loaded up on BTC-holder MSTR shares but failed to file a timely disclosure, according to a report by nonpartisan news outlet NOTUS.

articles.title: FBI director discloses Strategy holdings months after deadline: Report
articles.snippet: Strategy is a registered US government contractor, though Kash Patel claimed that “no current conflict exists” with his $100,001 and $250,000 worth of the company’s stock that he reported late.

articles.title: FBI Director Kash Patel's Undisclosed Stock Buy in Bitcoin Giant Strategy Is Down 44%
articles.snippet: FBI Director Kash Patel failed to disclose a significant purchase of stock in Bitcoin treasury firm Strategy from last November.
